author_notes: Slot slot_152 targets website-templates/design-studio_one-page-template, a runnable static Bak-One design-studio one-page marketing page served from its prebuilt static output (the Gulp 3.9.1 + node-sass toolchain does not install under Node 22, so the prebuilt build/ is served and the built HTML/CSS/JS are edited directly). The product-grade repair fixes an incompletely integrated 'portfolio case captions' component across four orthogonal axes: the case-lens control row overflows a 390px phone (no_horizontal_overflow, tol 24), the shared case-ledger rail is missing from the about and footer sections (cross-section dom_assertions on case-rail--portfolio / --team / --footer), the rail's off-system dark surface diverges from the ivory/mint reference (visual_regression on desktop_portfolio, mobile_portfolio, desktop_footer), and the case-lens readout stays stale after a click (interaction_assertions on desktop_case_lens, changed_from desktop_portfolio). Content and DOM are identical across the reference and the layout-defect baseline except for the graded stylesheet and lens script; the bad leg fails all four gates while the baseline fails the first three. Reference is runtime-clean (0 console/0 network) across all sixteen states.
design_constraints: Stay inside the existing one-page Bak-One flat design system: white portfolio band, teal #1bbc9b filter pills and hover overlay, circular thumbnails, compact uppercase navigation, centered section titles, and an ivory/mint case-ledger rail.

Repair the case-ledger component (its cross-section rail, the case-lens row and the lens readout wiring) rather than adding a new route, modal, carousel, unrelated gallery, broad redesign, or separate marketing section.
The case-lens buttons should wrap onto multiple lines on narrow viewports rather than being forced onto one line wider than the screen.
The shared case-ledger rail must appear in the portfolio, about and footer sections with identical case captions and on-palette styling.
Do not remove or bypass the existing jQuery portfolio filter classes, data-cat categories, static image paths, one-page anchors, or contact/team sections.

change_completion: The 390px mobile portfolio, initial, and contact captures show no horizontal page overflow after the filter-row repair.
The portfolio filter pills wrap and remain readable on mobile instead of spilling off the edge.
The distinct portfolio case captions and studio intro copy remain present in the captured portfolio states.
design_consistency: The repair preserves the teal flat-design filter pills, circular thumbnail grid, translucent hover overlay, and centered section rhythm.
Desktop and tablet portfolio layout is unchanged by the mobile filter-row repair.
regression: Existing header navigation, hero, portfolio filters, team cards, contact form/card, footer, and one-page anchors remain visible.
Existing portfolio and team image assets remain loaded in captured states.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures avoid horizontal overflow.
Mobile portfolio/contact states keep filter labels, team summaries, contact information, and footer readable.

metadata.design_goal: repair the portfolio case-ledger component so its shared 'case captions' rail appears consistently across the portfolio, about and footer sections, its case-lens control wraps without horizontal overflow on mobile, and its lens readout stays in sync after interaction -- all inside the local flat teal visual system
metadata.source_repo_kind: static Bak-One design-studio one-page marketing template with Pug source, built HTML, Sass portfolio component, jQuery category filters, circular portfolio images, team cards, contact card, and footer

problem_statement: In website-templates/design-studio_one-page-template, the Bak-One design-studio one-page marketing template ships an incompletely integrated 'portfolio case captions' component. The case-ledger rail (a shared strip listing the studio's signature cases -- Harbor Rebrand Kit, Fjord Commerce UI, Tidewater Poster Set) is meant to appear consistently in the portfolio, about and footer sections, and the portfolio section carries a 'case lens' control whose readout names the focused lens. Three defects break it: (1) the case-lens control row is pinned to a single non-wrapping line wider than a 390px phone, so the whole page scrolls sideways on mobile; (2) the shared case-ledger rail is missing from the about and footer sections (or styled with an off-system dark surface), breaking the cross-section visual system; (3) the case-lens readout does not update to the freshly clicked lens. Repair the component so the case-lens row wraps and fits at 390px with no horizontal overflow, the shared case-ledger rail is present and on-palette in the portfolio, about AND footer sections, and clicking a lens button live -updates the readout -- all while preserving the flat teal visual system, circular portfolio grid, category filters, hover overlays, one-page navigation, team cards, contact card and footer, and the desktop/tablet layout.
required_content: Fix the case-lens control row so it wraps and fits within a 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal page overflow (document width must not exceed the viewport beyond a small tolerance).

Ensure the shared case-ledger rail (class case-rail, with case-rail--portfolio, case-rail--team and case-rail--footer section modifiers) is present in the portfolio, about and footer sections, each showing the distinct case captions (Harbor Rebrand Kit, Fjord Commerce UI, Tidewater Poster Set).
Keep the case-ledger rail on the local flat palette (ivory card surface, teal/mint case names) so it matches the reference visual system rather than an off-system dark surface.
Wire the case-lens buttons so clicking a lens live-updates the #case-readout terminal readout to name the selected lens (for example 'Lens: Product UI').

Preserve the working All / Web design / Graphic design / Flat design filters, their filtered states, the teal hover caption overlays, the circular thumbnail grid, portfolio and team image assets, page header navigation and footer.

The repair must be a real layout fix observable as no horizontal overflow in the captured mobile states; it must not merely hide overflow with overflow-x:hidden while the case-lens row still exceeds the viewport.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the full one-page marketing flow, header, hero, portfolio, team, contact, and footer after the component repair.
desktop_portfolio plus the three filter states protect the Portfolio filter controls and circular grid layout.
desktop_portfolio_hover_flat, desktop_portfolio_hover_web, and desktop_portfolio_hover_graphic are the primary completion states for visible repaired captions after hover actions.
desktop_team and desktop_contact protect unrelated team and contact components from being rewritten during the repair.
mobile_portfolio and mobile_contact protect responsive section stacking, filter wrapping, contact card text, and footer behavior.
